S. 1071 would prescribe various authorities and policies that govern national defense and foreign affairs. Many of those
changes would affect authorizations of appropriations. The bill also would affect direct spending, as shown in the table.
Those effects stem mainly from changes to benefits for public safety officers, military retirement programs, and authority
to dispose of material from the National Defense Stockpile.
